examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

examples.text: Лидия Алексеевна, успокойтесь, пожалуйста! Вы как маленькая себя ведёте.
examples.trans: Lydia Alexeyevna, calm down, please! You're behaving like a little girl.

выгнать.gloss: to kick out, to evict, to drive out

meanings.en: to kick out, to drive out

examples.text: Для тебя она добрая. А меня она выгонит!
examples.trans: She's kind to you. But she'll kick me out!

examples.text: Значит, меня не выгонят со службы?
examples.trans: Does that mean I won't be fired from service?

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: followed by genitive plural in nominative/accusative

examples.text: Я уже вам сто раз говорила. Я брала двадцать тысяч, вернула тридцать!
examples.trans: I've already told you a hundred times. I borrowed twenty thousand, paid back thirty!

meanings.note: female child; patronising when used to a teenager or adult

examples.trans: Girl, pass me the sugar, please.
A little girl is playing in the yard.

examples.text: Очень плохой кофе. Девочка, дай сахар, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Very bad coffee. Girl, pass me the sugar, please.
Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: irregular feminine declension with stem дочер-

examples.text: Простите, это собака дочери. Я с ней гуляю пока.
examples.trans: Sorry, it's my daughter's dog. I'm walking her for now.
An unfamiliar fellow came up to us.
Speak, where is your uncle? Where is the commander?

examples.text: Тихо, вы правы. Да, я здоров.
examples.trans: Quiet, you're right. Yes, I'm healthy.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Do you take me for an idiot?

examples.text: У вас даже синяка нет. Вы меня за идиота держите?
examples.trans: You don't even have a bruise. Do you take me for an idiot?

examples.text: Боже мой! Какой же я идиот!
examples.trans: My goodness! What an idiot I am!

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.en: to get worked up, to fume
meanings.note: Literally 'to boil oneself', from 'кипятить', to boil, and 'кипяток', boiling water. Casual speech.

examples.trans: Why are you so worked up?
Don't get worked up, it's fine.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: Это секрет, который умрёт вместе со мной.
examples.trans: It's a secret that will die with me.

meanings.note: В любой момент = at any moment.

examples.text: Любая обезьяна эти выборы выиграет! Ты что, хуже обезьяны?
examples.trans: Any monkey will win this election! What, are you worse than a monkey?

meanings.note: From Latin 'momentum' (movement, brief span of time).

examples.text: А мне что-то уже не хочется. Момент упущен.
examples.trans: Somehow I don't feel like it anymore. The moment has passed.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.
Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

examples.text: Наверное, что-то серьёзное у вас. Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!

examples.text: Ну где я сейчас найду грузчиков?
examples.trans: Well, where am I going to find movers right now?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: В таком случае мне здесь больше нечего делать.
examples.trans: In that case, there is nothing left for me to do here.
There is nothing to do here.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: С первого раза = the first time.

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

examples.text: Ты что, с первого раза не понимаешь?
examples.trans: What, you don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: платить за + accusative = to pay for

examples.text: А вашу работу вернуть можно. И мы хорошо платим.
examples.trans: But we can get your job back for you. And we pay well.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: Посиди с ним = stay with him.

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал.
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once.

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал. В Москву звал замуж!
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once. He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!

examples.text: Что смотрите, бандерлоги? Вы совсем страх потеряли?
examples.trans: What are you staring at, you monkeys? Have you lost all fear?

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

meanings.en: to have to, to be forced to
meanings.note: impersonal with dative: мне придётся = I'll have to

examples.trans: I'm going to have to torture you.
We had to wait a long time.

examples.text: Ты что, очкарик, не понимаешь? Мне тебя мучить придётся.
examples.trans: Don't you get it, four-eyes? I'm going to have to torture you.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!
They'll kick you out after the first booze-up.

examples.text: А вы и на пьянку не опаздываете!
examples.trans: And you're never late for a booze-up either!

meanings.note: From 'пьяный', drunk. It names the habit; a single binge is 'пьянка'.

examples.trans: Who'll put up with your drinking?

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: Higher in age or class rank.

examples.trans: All the upper grades are going tomorrow.
I cannot contradict an older man.
Did you really suddenly get scared?

examples.text: Он ночью страшно и громко храпит!
examples.trans: At night he snores terribly and loudly!

examples.text: Или счёт в банке. Потому что они все обманщики.
examples.trans: Or a bank account. Because they are all cheats.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

терпеть.gloss: to bear, to put up with; to hold on

meanings.en: to put up with, to bear

meanings.note: E.g. to wait for the toilet.

examples.text: Маленькие умеют терпеть, а взрослые нет, понял?
examples.trans: Little ones can hold on, but grown-ups can't, got it?

related.gloss: to be patient for a while

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: the noun after it is genitive plural: тысячи мест

examples.text: Мы построим кластер. Это тысячи рабочих мест.
examples.trans: We will build the cluster. That means thousands of jobs.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to assure, to try to convince
meanings.note: From 'вера', faith, the same root as 'верить', to believe. 'Уверяю тебя' means 'I assure you'; the standard form takes the accusative 'тебя', and 'я тебе уверяю', as Nagiyev says here, is a common colloquial slip.

examples.text: Я тебе уверяю, что всё не так страшно.
examples.trans: I assure you, it's not as bad as all that.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.en: to quit, to resign (from a job)

examples.text: Ты можешь уволиться в любой момент.
examples.trans: You can quit at any moment.

учиться.gloss: to study, to be a student; to learn

meanings.en: to study, to be a student
to learn how to do something

examples.text: Но вы же с ним учились вместе!
examples.trans: But you studied together with him!

examples.text: А я всё выучила. Я хорошо учусь.
examples.trans: And I've learned everything. I do well at school.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
